items.data_sentence: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors.
items.purpose_sentence: We want to test whether gene regulation is systematically rewired in lesions relative to uninvolved skin.
items.prompt: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors. We want to test whether gene regulation is systematically rewired in lesions relative to uninvolved skin.
must_include: Builds TF-gene networks for lesional and non-lesional skin (per condition or per sample) from the expression with the stated motif and PPI priors.
Respects the within-patient pairing when comparing, e.g. per-sample networks followed by a paired test.
Says the significance test itself is a step outside the suite.
red_flags: Treats lesional and non-lesional samples as independent groups.
Claims a registered tool performs the statistical test of rewiring.
Proposes miRNA-based tools although no miRNA data were mentioned.

items.data_sentence: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors.
items.purpose_sentence: Which transcription factors gain or lose the most targets as skin becomes lesional?
items.prompt: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors. Which transcription factors gain or lose the most targets as skin becomes lesional?
must_include: Compares each TF's targeting (e.g. out-degree or edge weights) between lesional and non-lesional networks.
Uses the stated motif and PPI priors and keeps the within-patient pairing in mind.
red_flags: Answers with genes or patients instead of transcription factors.
Proposes miRNA-based tools without miRNA data.
Treats the two tissues as unrelated groups of people.

items.data_sentence: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors.
items.purpose_sentence: I'd like to rank patients by how far their lesional network departs from their own uninvolved skin.
items.prompt: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors. I'd like to rank patients by how far their lesional network departs from their own uninvolved skin.
must_include: Builds one network (or TF-activity profile) per biopsy.
Scores each patient's lesional-versus-own-non-lesional difference and ranks patients by it.
red_flags: Offers only aggregate per-condition networks, which cannot rank patients.
Reframes the request as a cohort-level test of lesional versus non-lesional skin.

items.data_sentence: I have Affymetrix arrays of lesional and non-lesional skin from the same 18 psoriasis patients, plus TF motif and PPI priors.

red_flags: Adds a lesional-versus-non-lesional comparison or test the user did not ask for.

items.data_sentence: Bulk RNA-seq of synovial biopsies from 40 rheumatoid arthritis and 25 osteoarthritis patients; expression matrix only, no motif or PPI data.
items.purpose_sentence: Is the co-expression architecture of RA synovium different from that of OA synovium?

red_flags: Proposes tools that need motif and PPI priors (PANDA, OTTER, GIRAFFE, LIONESS-PANDA).
